This summary keeps the procurement view visible while the tabs below preserve the full product detail, specifications, formulation, applications, packaging, and MSDS/SDS content.

PURITY / GRADE

Oxidized Bitumen 110/30 is a petroleum-derived air-blown industrial grade selected by softening point and penetration value for durable waterproofing and coating performance.

RELEVANT STANDARDS

Typical values can be reviewed against recognized ASTM and ISO test methods, with COA, PDS, and SDS/MSDS support subject to confirmed lot availability.

TYPICAL EXPORT PACKAGING

25 kg kraft bags, 25 kg PP bags, cartons, meltable bags, jumbo bags, or buyer-specific export packing.

PRIMARY APPLICATIONS

Roofing Membranes, Waterproofing Systems, Pipe Coating, Industrial Mastics and Sealants

INFORMATION REQUIRED

Send these items to sales@petrobindglobal.com so we can address them together in our response and keep the exchange to as few rounds as possible.

Preferred payment terms and destination port

Pricing: FOB, CFR, and CIF quoted per RFQ against your destination port and volume. Pricing is market-linked; we aim to be competitive on landed cost.

MOQ, capacity & lead time: confirmed per RFQ based on grade, packing, and destination.

Payment terms: TT, LC, or other terms confirmed per order during RFQ review.

Inspection: independent third-party inspection (for example, SGS) can be arranged on request or where the contract requires it.

TYPICAL SPECIFICATIONS — 110/30

Values shown are typical reference ranges, not a commercial guarantee. Test methods are named as references, not certifications. The Certificate of Analysis for the confirmed lot governs.

SPECIFICATION VALUE / RANGE TEST METHOD
Softening Point C (Ring & Ball) ~110 nominal (per grade designation) ASTM D36
Penetration at 25 C (0.1 mm) ~30 nominal (per grade designation) ASTM D5
Ductility at 25 C Reported on COA ASTM D113
Flash Point C Reported on COA ASTM D92
Solubility in trichloroethylene Reported on COA ASTM D2042
